pick.title: Connect Feishu
pick.lede: Pick a team's Feishu app and authorize with your own Feishu account.
pick.none: None of your teams has a Feishu app set up yet.
pick.noneHint: A Feishu app is set on a team: a company's team sets its company's custom app; on your own, set one on your personal team.
pick.setUpPersonal: Set one up in personal settings

team.title: Feishu app
team.lede: The custom app the team's members connect Feishu with. Each person still authorizes with their own Feishu account.
team.ledePersonal: The custom app you connect Feishu with: built in your company's Feishu, authorized with your own Feishu account.
team.adminOnly: Only a team admin can set the Feishu app.
team.secretHint: Leave empty to keep the saved one
team.loadFailed: The Feishu app failed to load
team.removeBody: Every Feishu connection made with this app stops working, and members have to connect again.
team.step1: On the Feishu developer console ({console}), create a custom app.
team.step2: Under Security Settings, add this redirect URL and turn on refreshing user_access_token:
team.step3: Under Permissions, choose batch import/export and paste this configuration, then apply for it:
team.step4: Under Version Management & Release, create and publish a version, available to the team members who will use it. You can give this reason, then wait for your company's Feishu admin to approve:
team.step4Personal: Under Version Management & Release, create and publish a version. Set availability to just yourself, which makes approval much easier. You can give this reason, then wait for your company's Feishu admin to approve:
team.step5: Enter the App ID and App Secret from Credentials & Basic Info above, and save.
team.reason: To search, read and edit a person's own Feishu documents as themselves on Cheese (okcheese.com). Only user-identity permissions are requested, and each person starts their own authorization.
